papers.summary_zh: 常见点云重建损失采用最近邻对应，容易让多个预测点聚集到同一目标，造成稀疏区域覆盖不足，而严格一一匹配计算昂贵。论文在成对距离构成的相似度矩阵上执行概率匹配，通过迭代归一化得到可微的一一对应近似，并解析选择温度减少调参。该损失在保持较低计算开销的同时改善点分布，作者在补全和生成网络中比较收敛速度及重建质量。
papers.venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38 Main Conference (NeurIPS 2025)

papers.title: AGHL: Anchor-Guided Point Cloud Registration Network With Hybrid Local Feature Perception
papers.venue_full: IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
papers.summary_zh: 无检测器点云配准方法容易忽略邻域中的混合局部特征，而全局注意力还会引入无关区域干扰。本文设计并行的局部感知分支，分别在欧氏空间和高维特征空间提取低层与高层信息，刻画点及其邻居的关联。随后以局部几何一致性筛选可靠锚点，引导跨点云注意力集中到可信区域，从而提高对应质量和刚体变换估计精度，并在真实机器人定位中验证泛化能力。
papers.abstract: Point cloud registration, which estimates a rigid transformation matrix between two point clouds, is a fundamental process in numerous applications. While existing detector-free techniques present exceptional performance, they overlook the extraction of hybrid local features that capture correlations between points and their neighbours, thereby limiting the quality of point cloud recognition. Moreover, these approaches typically treat point clouds as sequential data and employ the transformer to integrate global context from all points, which inevitably introduces interference from irrelevant regions, hence affecting the registration accuracy. In this work, we propose a novel detector-free approach AGHL to address these challenges. For the first issue, AGHL introduces a hybrid local feature perception module that designs two parallel branches to concurrently extract low-level and high-level local features, which effectively encode the correlations between each point and its neighborhood points in both Euclidean space and high-dimensional feature space. For the second issue, AGHL develops an anchor-guided cross attention that adheres to the local geometric consistency to constrain the network's attention on reliable anchors, thereby effectively suppressing interference from irrelevant regions. Benefiting from these techniques, AGHL achieves impressive point cloud registration accuracy across all synthetic, indoor, and outdoor datasets. Furthermore, we build an experimental platform and conduct a real-world robot localization experiment, with results showing the strong generalization ability of AGHL.

papers.title: A Self-Adaptive Feature Extraction Method for Aerial-View Geo-Localization
papers.venue_full: IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
papers.summary_zh: 无人机航拍图与卫星图之间存在高度、倾角和建筑尺度变化，固定区域划分容易使对应地物落入不同特征块，降低跨视角定位效果。论文提出自适应特征提取网络，利用全局信息指导仿射特征对齐，再通过显著性引导的自适应区域划分聚合局部表征，无需额外的区域标注。方法联合处理尺度变化与局部对应偏差，并在无人机地理定位基准上检验对不同飞行条件的适应能力。

papers.title: A New Quantitative Measure for Separation and Penetration Between Convex Primitives and a Point Cloud or a Triangle Mesh
papers.venue_full: IEEE Transactions on Robotics
papers.summary_zh: 碰撞判断不仅需要区分物体是否接触，还需要高效度量凸几何体与点云或三角网格的分离和穿透程度。本文以几何体绕质心缩放至接触目标的最小比例作为统一度量，用大于、等于或小于一对应三种状态。大部分基本情形可闭式计算，其余采用一维搜索；再利用计算产生的分离平面排除大量无关点对，使整体最小比例查询避免逐一穷举，提高几何关系计算效率。
papers.abstract: This article presents a new efficient way to quantitatively measure separation and penetration between a collection of convex primitives (including ellipsoids, capsules, cylinders, convex polyhedra, and triangles) and a point cloud or a triangle mesh. First, the minimum scaling factor of a convex primitive with respect to its centroid to contact a point or a triangle is proposed as a new distance metrics, which can be greater than, equal to, or less than one, implying that the point or the triangle is separated from, just contacts, or penetrates into the convex primitive. It can be computed mostly in closed form or occasionally with a 1-D gradient descent search, which is much faster than computing the Euclidean distance. Furthermore, an efficient algorithm is proposed to compute the smallest minimum scaling factor of convex primitives in a collection to a point cloud or a triangle mesh. It is based on the discovery that computing the minimum scaling factor of a convex primitive to a point or a triangle yields a plane separating more points or triangles from this or other convex primitives. Then, the overall smallest scaling factor can be found by checking only a few pairs of primitives and points or triangles, being significantly faster than the exhaustive search. In various numerical examples and comparison with the existing algorithms, the proposed metrics and algorithm show superior or comparable efficiency.

papers.title: 4D3R: Motion-Aware Neural Reconstruction and Rendering of Dynamic Scenes from Monocular Videos
papers.abstract: Novel view synthesis from monocular videos of dynamic scenes with unknown camera poses remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and graphics. While recent advances in 3D representations such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have shown promising results for static scenes, they struggle with dynamic content and typically rely on pre-computed camera poses. We present 4D3R, a pose-free dynamic neural rendering framework that decouples static and dynamic components through a two-stage approach. Our method first leverages 3D foundational models for initial pose and geometry estimation, followed by motion-aware refinement. 4D3R introduces two key technical innovations: (1) a motion-aware bundle adjustment (MA-BA) module that combines transformer-based learned priors with SAM2 for robust dynamic object segmentation, enabling more accurate camera pose refinement; and (2) an efficient Motion-Aware Gaussian Splatting (MA-GS) representation that uses control points with a deformation field MLP and linear blend skinning to model dynamic motion, significantly reducing computational cost while maintaining high-quality reconstruction. Extensive experiments on real-world dynamic datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves up to 1.8dB PSNR improvement over state-of-the-art methods, particularly in challenging scenarios with large dynamic objects, while reducing computational requirements by 5× compared to previous dynamic scene representations.

papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting based Scene-independent Relocalization with Unidirectional and Bidirectional Feature Fusion
papers.summary_zh: 三维高斯表示同时支持几何对应和可微图像渲染，为相机重定位提供互补线索。本文先通过GS-RelocNet建立图像像素与三维高斯的对应关系，估计初始位姿，再依据渲染图像进一步优化。两阶段分别引入单向二维三维特征融合和双向图像特征融合，加强信息共享。研究在多个室内外基准中检验场景无关定位，并分析融合模块和位姿细化的贡献。

preprints.summary_zh: RangeNav提出一种轻量LiDAR距离图像编码器，用于密集人群与杂乱场景中的机器人导航。方法上采用各向异性卷积与圆形填充处理距离图像极端宽高比与方位接缝，在合成数据上以距离重建、语义分割和BEV预测组合目标预训练，冻结后用于策略学习。实验在并行RL仿真中对比重建-only基线，语义与BEV监督分别提升成功率32.03与23.73个百分点，并在Unitree B2-W四足机器人上零样本实机穿越人群、低光与工地，验证有限视场深度策略不及的鲁棒性。

preprints.summary_zh: 本文针对现有3D视觉语言模型基准中因依赖边界框作为空间提示导致的“语义泄漏”问题，提出以单3D点替代框的点基定位提示协议。作者先用仅给框坐标的盲LLM证明框提供类别捷径，点提示下其准确率从36.4%降至18.0%。基于此，设计P^3-VLM三路径（位置、任务、上下文感知）无检测器、场景中心且兼容3D高斯输入的模型，在ScanNet Nr3D等上以52.1%准确率取得点基定位描述最优，并提升鲁棒性与分布外泛化。

preprints.title: OmniVLoc: Topo-metric Visual Localization for Omnidirectional Cameras
preprints.summary_zh: 本文针对全向相机视觉定位在场景变化和光照变化下精度不足的问题，提出OmniVLoc系统。该方法基于拓扑度量框架，融合全局位置识别与单目深度估计，形成多约束视觉定位范式；通过尺度感知位姿图优化与球面光束法平差恢复度量级位姿，并设计分层验证机制过滤各阶段错误输出以提升鲁棒性。作者在公开数据集与自建数据集上进行了大量实验验证系统准确性与可靠性，并计划公开代码与数据。

preprints.title: MatchCityLoc: Aerial Localization in LoD City Models via Surface Normal Matching

preprints.title: EchoNav: Evidential BEV Completion from Historical Observations for Visual Navigation
preprints.summary_zh: 该文提出EchoNav框架，用于杂乱环境下的视觉导航。方法结合时序聚合与占据补全，基于短RGB序列预测证据化鸟瞰图（BEV）表示。解码器适配冻结的VGGT-Omega特征，利用单元权重与可学习的无更新选项融合历史残差提议，无需深度、相机位姿或显式几何变换即可在最新自车坐标系生成局部地图。证据模型分离已观测自由空间，并对其余区域预测带置信度的占据。系统在仿真及轮式、四足、人形机器人上评估，仿真双目标导航成功率达89.6%，实机60次试验成功率为73.3%。

preprints.title: TNVD-SC: Diagnosing Scan Context Failures in Forests with Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distributions
preprints.summary_zh: 针对森林中因植被重复和地形不平导致激光雷达位置识别困难的问题，作者诊断Scan Context方法，将其候选检索与精细匹配分离，发现地形归一化对垂直分布单元提升显著。据此提出TNVD-SC，保留SC环形扇区结构并编码地形相对垂直概率分布。在标准TreeLoc++协议下达到91.83%平均R@1，并在NCLT评估中达85.14%。还给出无损计数编码实现，降低描述符体积与延迟而不改变检索结果。

preprints.title: PlanarCityLoc: Breaking Silhouette Ambiguity in LoD Aerial Localization via 3D Planes

preprints.title: LateMatch: Breaking the Interaction Bottleneck via Cacheable Matching for Efficient Visual Localization
preprints.summary_zh: 本文针对边缘设备上视觉定位中深度特征匹配计算成本过高的问题，指出标准匹配器将图像内上下文构建与图像间匹配逐层交织造成交互瓶颈。为此提出LateMatch，将图像间交互推迟到网络末层，使图像内处理可离线缓存；并引入E-SToRE利用交互块香农熵下降动态缩减令牌数。在HPatches、ScanNet、MegaDepth、ETH-3D和Aachen等数据集上，LateMatch将有效计算成本降低2倍以上，E-SToRE额外节省10%至14%且精度损失可忽略。

preprints.title: Vision-Guided Closed-Loop Autonomous Navigation of Light-Driven Janus Microbots

preprints.summary_zh: 针对仓库等低纹理环境中点特征视觉里程计易失效的问题，本文在CUDA加速的cuVSLAM中扩展线特征。线用Plücker坐标与4-DOF正交表示，将Cauchy鲁棒点线残差加入每帧高斯牛顿位姿求解与滑窗BA，并自适应加权使线在特征稀少时承担更多估计。方法不引入独立估计器。实验在TUM RGB-D Freiburg3与Replica数据集以SE(3)对齐评测，线特征降低绝对轨迹误差并减少跟踪失败。

preprints.title: KinoUAV: A Benchmark for Safe and Stable UAV Vision-Language Navigation with Kinodynamic Modeling
preprints.summary_zh: 该文提出KinoUAV基准，面向无人机安全稳定视觉-语言导航。动机是现有方法缺乏运动学建模与安全间距，导致偏航率高、易碰撞。方法上，构建分层运动学轨迹生成流水线，在速度、加速度与加加速度约束下分段生成轨迹；数据集引入方向自由空间距离标签，KinoUAV-Agent预测该距离并生成安全动作，解耦感知与决策；设Cruise-Seek任务先进入目标区再搜索。实验在KinoUAV上进行，对比显示其成功率更高且偏航与碰撞率更低。

preprints.title: Into the LidarVerse: A Real-Time Unified LiDAR World Model Across Tasks and Sensors
preprints.summary_zh: 本文提出LidarVerse，一个实时统一LiDAR世界模型，用于跨任务与传感器的传感器仿真。现有方法分重建式与生成式两类，各有局限。作者用通用tokenizer将LiDAR距离序列映射至共享潜空间，双向教师模型以LiDAR前缀、HD地图、空间缓存及文本为条件；再蒸馏为四步自回归因果学生模型，配合时间/空间缓存实现实时长时序推演。支持32/64/128线及未知扫描模式，在三种评估协议上报告了性能指标与11FPS实时性。
